detailed_description:
A realistic live-action video set in a minimalist recording studio with pure white walls and bright, even lighting. [Shot 1] The video opens immediately with <Subject 1> speaking. She stands in the center of the white studio. The shot begins as a medium close-up from the waist up, showing her elegant posture and the detailed layers of her blue and silver hanfu. Her expression is calm yet carries a hint of melancholy. As she speaks, the camera performs a slow, smooth push-in, gradually moving closer to her face. The focus sharpens on her delicate features, the silver hair ornaments catching the light, and the subtle movement of her lips as she articulates the words. By the end of the shot, the frame is a tight close-up on her face, capturing her eyes and the quiet intensity of her delivery. <Subject 1> (S1) says: [English] "Seamless, Color-Consistent Long-Context Video"
